description: Replacing combustible external cladding materials (ACM & XPS spandrels), installing fire cavity barriers, breather membranes and other associated materials. No change to overall aesthetic appearance of the building (Application for a Certificate of Lawfulness).
decision_conditions: The Council is satisfied, on the basis of the information submitted, that the proposed works comprise the replacement of existing external cladding materials and associated elements and would not result in any material alteration to the external appearance of the building.

The proposed works are therefore not considered to constitute development within the meaning of Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended). In particular, the works fall within Section 55(2)(a)(ii), which excludes works affecting only the interior of a building or works which do not materially affect the external appearance of the building.
Accordingly, planning permission is not required for the proposal described in the application and shown on the submitted plans.

The applicant is advised that separate requirements may arise under the Building Safety Act 2022 and associated legislation. The applicant should seek independent advice and ensure compliance with all relevant statutory requirements before undertaking the works.

This Certificate only confirms that planning permission is not required for the works described in the application and shown on the approved plans. It does not remove the need to obtain any other consent, permission or approval that may be required by legislation other than the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
